messages:
alex_sales: Hey @rhea_csm - passing off MirrorWell pilot (MW-TRIAL-11). 14-day pilot begins Mon. Key asks: SAML SSO, dedicated pool for ~25 qps, and embeddings for clinical note search + rerank. Main contact: sasha@mirrorwell.com. Renewal signal: strong if median latency < 110ms and average embed cost < $0.00042/token.
rhea_csm: Thanks Alex. Quick confirm: who will own VPC peering vs. data mapping for notes ingestion?
alex_sales: Matt (infra) will own peering/provision; CS (rhea + alex) will handle mapping and mappings verification. They've asked for a 30-min handover Mon 2pm PT.
matt_infra: Noted. I'll file INF-9807 for reserved pool + static egress IPs in us-west-2. Constraint: their firewall team requires cert pinning and an approved peering window. Recommend prewarm to mitigate day-0 tail latency.
ben_support: Support rota: @ben_support weekdays 8-6 PT. I'll create SUP-6233 and #mirrorwell-support (private). Need runbook link and escalation matrix.
alex_sales: Runbook uploaded: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/mirrorwell (internal). Security addendum in Drive.
rhea_csm: Actions I tracked: 1) confirm Mon 2pm handover (owner: alex_sales) 2) CS onboarding plan draft (owner: rhea_csm) 3) INF-9807 follow-up (owner: matt_infra) 4) SAML metadata exchange (owner: sasha@mirrorwell / rhea_csm). Any SLA/renewal notes to add?
matt_infra: INF-9807 ETA: provisioned by Thu if peering window approved. We'll use quant profile q5_8 to meet cost targets; note small accuracy variance - capture eval prompts.
rhea_csm: I'll run a focused eval on q5_8 before pilot. Need 10 priority prompts from the customer to validate clinical retrieval & rerank - @alex_sales can you request that?
alex_sales: Asked Sasha; she said they'll share prompts by Fri EOD.
ben_support: Created SUP-6233 and added monitoring defaults. Alerts: avg latency > 140ms OR error rate > 1.5% triggers page. I'll add playbook steps to runbook.
alert-bot: alert-bot: INF-9807 created and assigned to matt_infra.
rhea_csm: Risk register: renewal risk = medium-high. Tech risks: peering approval delays, KV cache warm-up, quantization-induced regressions. Ops risk: timeline slip affecting pilot window.
alex_sales: Sales asks: emphasize embedding unit economic targets in customer comms. Capture weekly cost-per-search and per-convo metrics.
rhea_csm: Weekly sync scheduled Thu 9am PT; invite sent to Sasha + internal owners. I'll set up shared feedback doc and regression tracker: https://redwood.internal/ops/mirrorwell-feedback.
matt_infra: Prewarm example for CS/support: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/prewarm -d '{"model":"embed-4-small","qps":25}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'. Run during allowed window to populate KV cache.
ben_support: I'll add warmup steps to runbook, plus a lightweight health-check script that hits a small set of sanity prompts post-prewarm.
alex_sales: Final ask: can CS/Support confirm owners here and immediate next steps?
rhea_csm: Owners confirmed: CS onboarding = rhea_csm; infra provisioning = matt_infra; support lead = ben_support; sales follow-ups = alex_sales. Next steps: 1) alex get prompts by Fri EOD, 2) matt update INF-9807 with IPs & peering window by Wed, 3) rhea publish onboarding plan by Wed EOD, 4) ben post runbook & healthcheck to #mirrorwell-support.
ben_support: Confirmed. I'll enable PagerDuty for SUP-6233 and run an initial monitor at 8:30am PT on pilot start.
alex_sales: Thanks team 44d I'll run the Mon 2pm handover and include MirrorWell infra lead.
rhea_csm: Thanks all 64c I'll prep eval harness and feedback doc ahead of the handover.
